Google Play In-App Review, in the Android app only (not loaded by web pages, not in the iPhone
app), unmodified, from Google's Maven repository (https://maven.google.com). It shows Google
Play's own rating card (https://developer.android.com/guide/playcore/in-app-review).

- com.google.android.play:review 2.0.2
- com.google.android.play:core-common 2.0.4 (needed by review)
- com.google.android.gms:play-services-basement 18.4.0 (needed by review)
- com.google.android.gms:play-services-tasks 18.2.0 (needed by review)

Copyright Google LLC. Not open source.

review and core-common: Play Core Software Development Kit Terms of Service,
https://developer.android.com/guide/playcore/license (Google allows copying and distributing
it as part of an app, without changing it).

play-services-basement and play-services-tasks: Android Software Development Kit License,
https://developer.android.com/studio/terms

Google states that these Google Play services libraries collect no end-user data
(https://developers.google.com/android/guides/play-data-disclosure); a rating a player gives
in the card goes to Google Play as a public review
(https://developer.android.com/guide/playcore/in-app-review, Data Safety).
